+++ b/deb/quadlet/tor-haproxy.container
@@ -30,7 +30,6 @@
 # bridges-mode.env ([Service] below) and this passes TOR_BRIDGES in; unset
 # stays unset and the image defaults to on. Not an EnvironmentFile= here:
 # that is podman's --env-file, which takes no `-` and needs the file.
-PodmanArgs=--env TOR_BRIDGES

 # systemd waits for the HealthCmd to pass) was reverted because it
 # gates the unit's Active=active transition on real DoT resolution
